description: Reliaburger's own Claude Code plugin, from its repository.
name: reliaburger

plugins.description: Reliaburger is a container orchestrator in one binary. Its CLI, `relish`, has a family of commands built for LLM agents, `relish agent`: each prints one line of JSON, never prompts and stays within a byte budget, and `relish agent source` reads the exact source the binary was built from.
plugins.name: reliaburger
